easy.def: Twisted and rough, like an old tree.

more.def: Rough, twisted and bumpy, usually from being very old, like the branches of an ancient tree.
examples: Birds nested in the gnarled branches of the ancient oak.
The old fisherman had gnarled hands from years of pulling in heavy nets.
A gnarled root pushed up through the path and tripped me.

more.def: To grind or bite your teeth together, as a sign of anger or pain.
examples: The wolf in the story gnashed its teeth.
He gnashed his teeth in frustration at the broken toy.
The monster gnashed its teeth and growled.
